subject: Execution slip & MAP triage: proposed replan and escalation
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@fintechco.com>, Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP update + request to rebase close date (FIN-2026-0142)

Hi Jessica / Fintech team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Following our internal review of the evaluation plan and your procurement timeline, we need to flag a couple of execution risks that materially affect our previously agreed close date (Nov 10). Summary below and an attached MAP with a proposed rebaseline.

Key slippage drivers:
- Procurement: FintechCo legal needs vendor appendix review and 2 legal touchpoints (you mentioned internal legal availability week of Nov 1).
- Evaluation scope: your security team added a request for audit-log exports and a short SOC-related questionnaire completion that will take ~5 business days.
- Integration window: SRE has a preferred maintenance window that shifts initial POC start by 4 business days.

Proposed mitigation and rebaseline (see attached FintechCo_MAP_v3.xlsx):
- Move milestone: Contract signing -> Nov 24 (2-week push)
- Parallelize: Complete SOC questionnaire in parallel with initial integration tasks; Redwood to provide dedicated SRE hours Nov 3–10.
- Contingency: If procurement stalls past Nov 10, propose temporary hosted MLP access (limited tokens) so your product team can continue front-end testing.

Ask: Can you confirm procurement availability and whether FintechCo can sign the updated timeline by Friday (Oct 30)? If signing before Nov 10 is still required, we should escalate to enable a one-time credit/concession to keep the original close.

Attachments: FintechCo_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), FintechCo_eval_plan_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@fintechco.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP update + request to rebase close date (FIN-2026-0142)

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear breakdown and the new MAP. Short answers:

- Legal: Confirmed we have two reviews queued; earliest internal sign-off is likely Nov 17 unless we compress reviews.
- SOC questionnaire: Security wants to run the questionnaire with our third-party audit team; they'll need sample exports and a small data-flow diagram — we can get those to you by Nov 3, but turnaround might be 5–7 business days.
- Maintenance window: SRE prefers Nov 11–13 for POC integration.

Given those constraints, your proposed Nov 24 contract date is reasonable. That said, leadership is sensitive to any further slip because this is our priority H2 initiative. If Redwood can provide short-term hosted access or demonstrable commit on audit-log export support (and a modest commercial concession), we should be able to keep the launch window for the feature close to the current plan.

Can you outline the specific concession options (credit %, trial token pool, or implementation SLA) and the exact SRE hours you propose? We should confirm before EOD Friday so procurement can schedule the reviews.

—Jessica
Jessica Park
Head of Product, FintechCo

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jessica Park <jessica.park@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP update + request to rebase close date (FIN-2026-0142)

Folks — quick technical note to feed the commercial options:

Mitigation we can offer immediately:
- Hosted MLP access: Provision a scoped hosted sandbox (500k tokens/month) for 4 weeks so the product team can continue UI testing.
- SRE support: 12 hours of dedicated SRE time for integration tasks (Nov 3–10), plus one emergency 4-hour troubleshooting buffer during the window.
- Audit logs: We can deliver a CSV export and schema sample within 48 hours once we have the sample dataset; production-grade continuous export requires minor config but we can commit to a delivery plan in the MAP.

Commercial options to discuss (pick one):
1) 7.5% one-time credit applied at contract execution if signed by Nov 10 (to offset the slippage risk).
2) No credit + 2-week extended evaluation token pool (additional 250k tokens) and deeper SRE cadence.
3) If procurement demands original dates, escalate to Sales Director for exception (we can look at 10% credit but need sign-off).

I recommend option 2 or 1 depending on how urgent they are. Option 2 reduces our cash exposure and keeps FintechCo moving.

Ava

- If FintechCo insists on original Nov 10 signing, they will ask for a deeper concession; we may need to approve up to 10% one-time credit to close.

Can you approve Option 2 now (non-revenue-impacting: token pool + 12 SRE hours) and authorize escalation to 10% credit if they insist on Nov 10? If you want a draft approval note, I can prepare one for signature.
